items.source: Create a new expression evaluation exception.
items.translation: 创建一个新的表达式求值异常。

items.source: message - description of the problem that occurred
position - the position in the expression where the problem occurred
items.translation: position - 问题在表达式中发生的位置

items.source: cause - the underlying cause of this exception
expressionString - the expression that could not be evaluated
Represent an exception that occurs during expression evaluation.
items.translation: 表示在表达式求值期间发生的异常。
